line_intersect.note: Expected, per carrier/lift/README.md SS6b/win32_pilot.md SS6a: this function's x87 arithmetic needs genuine 80-bit extended precision (every intermediate stays in the FPU register stack across the ua/ub range checks and the final +0.5/truncation); the LIFTED form hit the identical fidelity gap under pf_x87_t=double (107-128 DIFFER per 50000 there) and only closed it with a software 80-bit backend (pf_x87_soft.h). src_check.exe here is built with plain MSVC cl.exe (no /arch override, no long-double/softfloat), so this is the same known gap, not a new one, and not a domain-modelling failure -- the comparison domain (EAX + *px + *py) is exactly the one the LIFTED form already proved complete. The source in src/icytower/line_intersect.c is recovered faithfully (same operation order as the disassembly, no algebraic simplification) and is believed correct; what is unverified is whether MSVC's default double model keeps enough of that precision. Promoted with this caveat rather than skipped, because win32_pilot.md SS6a already names the fix (compile with real 80-bit x87, e.g. GCC -mfpmath=387, or bind the softfloat backend) as a build-configuration question, not a source-recovery one; carrier bind is pending a build configuration proven bit-exact.
